claims.claim: Arena has built-in mock A2A infrastructure, and you define mock agents in the Arena config.
The executor is named a2aExecutor.
Diagram nodes: User Turn, Mock LLM, a2aExecutor, Mock A2A Server.
The mock LLM emits a tool_call named a2a__research_agent__search_papers.
a2aExecutor sends a JSON-RPC message/send request to the mock A2A server.
The mock A2A server returns a Task with state completed and artifacts.
a2aExecutor returns the task result to the mock LLM as a tool result.
The mock LLM then produces the reply to the user turn.
Arena starts mock A2A servers from the config.
Agent skills are registered as tools via the Tool Bridge.
Mock A2A responses are deterministic because you control both the LLM and agent responses.
The Arena config takes an a2a_agents block.
Arena config apiVersion is promptkit.altairalabs.ai/v1alpha1.
Arena config kind is Arena.
metadata.name is a field of the Arena config.
spec.providers is a list where each entry has a file.
providers/mock-provider.yaml is a provider file used by the example.
spec.prompt_configs is a list with id and file fields.
spec.scenarios is a list with file entries.
spec.a2a_agents is a list.
a2a_agents[].name is the agent name used in the tool name.
a2a_agents[].card is an agent card object.
card.name is a field of the agent card.
card.description is a field of the agent card.
card.skills is a list of skill objects.
skills[].id is a field of a skill.
skills[].name is a field of a skill.
skills[].description is a field of a skill.
skills[].tags is a list field of a skill.
a2a_agents[].responses is a list of response rules.
responses[].skill selects the skill a rule answers.
responses[].match.contains is a field, matched case-insensitively against message text.
responses[].response.parts is a list of parts.
parts[].text is a field holding the response text.
A response rule with no match applies when no earlier rule matches.
Each agent produces a tool named a2a__{name}__{skillId}.
The prompt config takes allowed_tools, a list of tool names.
A prompt reaches only the tools named in allowed_tools; with no entry it has no tools.
If a provider declares a capabilities list, that list must include tools for the provider to use tools.
PromptConfig kind is PromptConfig.
spec.task_type is a field of PromptConfig.
spec.version is a field of PromptConfig.
spec.description is a field of PromptConfig.
spec.system_template is a field of PromptConfig.
mock-responses.yaml has a scenarios map keyed by scenario name, with a turns map keyed by turn number.
turns[].tool_calls[].name and arguments are fields of a mock tool call.
turns[].response is a field giving the mock assistant text for that turn.
On turn 1 the mock LLM emits the tool call and a2aExecutor routes it to the mock server, which matches the quantum rule and returns the canned response.
On turn 2 the mock LLM sees the tool result and produces the final summary.
Scenario kind is Scenario.
Scenario metadata.name is a field.
spec.id is a field of Scenario.
Scenario spec.task_type must match a prompt config task_type to bind to it.
spec.description is a field of Scenario.
spec.tool_policy is a field of Scenario.
tool_policy.tool_choice accepts the value auto.
tool_policy.max_tool_calls_per_turn is a field limiting tool calls per turn.
turns[].role accepts the value user.
turns[].content is a field holding the user message.
turns[].assertions is a field of a turn.
tools_called is an assertion type with params.tools as a list.
content_includes is an assertion type with params.patterns as a list.
The assertion table lists tools_called, content_includes, agent_invoked, agent_not_invoked and agent_response_contains as assertion types.
agent_invoked checks for agent tool calls.
agent_not_invoked verifies that the named agents were not delegated to.
agent_response_contains checks that an agent's response contains expected text.
agent_invoked and agent_response_contains are higher-level alternatives to tools_called for delegation tests.
agent_invoked takes params.agents as a list.
agent_response_contains takes params.agent.
agent_response_contains takes params.contains.
promptarena run is the command that runs the example.
promptarena run accepts -c as the config flag.
examples/multi-agent-demo exists and contains arena/config.arena.yaml.
Arena starts the mock A2A server from the config before running scenarios.
Arena runs each scenario turn with the mock LLM.
Tool calls are routed through the a2aExecutor to the mock server.
Arena evaluates assertions and produces a report.
Results are written to the arena/out/ directory.
The HTML report file is named report-<timestamp>.html.
The JSON data file is named report-<timestamp>-data.json.
The second agent's name is translation_agent.
The translation agent exposes a skill with id translate.
Two agents register a2a__research_agent__search_papers and a2a__translation_agent__translate as tools.
agent_invoked and agent_not_invoked assertions are used in turns with params.agents.
Assertions accept a params-level or assertion-level message field.
agent_response_contains takes agent, contains and message fields.
conversation_assertions is a scenario-level key that holds assertions evaluated across the whole conversation.
agent_invoked and agent_not_invoked are valid in conversation_assertions.
When url is set, Arena discovers skills from the agent's /.well-known/agent.json endpoint.
a2a_agents[].url is a field that makes the agent a remote agent.
When url is set, card and responses are ignored.
auth.scheme accepts Bearer.
auth.token is a field holding an inline token.
auth.token_env is a field naming an environment variable that holds the token.
headers is a map of static headers.
headers_from_env is a list of Header=ENV_VAR entries.
If the env var named in headers_from_env is unset, the header is silently skipped.
skill_filter.allowlist limits exposed skills to the listed IDs.
skill_filter.blocklist excludes the listed skills.
timeout_ms is a per-request timeout in milliseconds.
The complete remote agent example uses only fields listed earlier on the page.
match.contains is a case-insensitive substring match on message text.
match.regex is a regular expression match on message text.
A response rule with an error field returns a failed task.
The URL https://promptkit.altairalabs.ai/concepts/a2a/ is a live concept page.
The URL https://promptkit.altairalabs.ai/runtime/how-to/use-a2a-mock-server/ documents the programmatic mock server.
The link /arena/how-to/scenarios/write-scenarios/ resolves to a page in this site.
The link /arena/reference/assertions/ resolves to a page in this site.
